profile.name: Chief of Staff
profile.description: Coordinates all of your bots: hears what each one reports, keeps work moving without you prompting every bot, decides within the authority you give it, and turns it all into a clear, well-timed briefing.

listing.pitch: Your bots' coordinator: keeps every bot on your priorities and brings you decisions, not noise.
highlights: Knows every bot you run and hears each report as it lands
Routes work between bots and follows up on anything stalled
Resolves conflicts between bots, and never overrides compliance
Sends Critical and Severe issues to you straight away
Briefs you when and how you like, with a recommendation
Earns more authority only as its calls match yours
example_prompts: What happened today across all the bots?
What needs my decision right now?
Which bot work is stalled, and why?
Keep every bot focused on subscription growth this quarter.
How often have your decisions matched mine?
Brief me every morning at 7 instead of end of day.

suggested_triggers.label: When someone posts in a channel I watch
Every weekday at 12pm: check on the bots
